parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The maximum length of the token is 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to ignore the status of the instance and forcibly restart the instance.
